channel.title: International Consortium of Investigative Journalists ICIJ - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Consortium of Investigative Journalists ICIJ (icij.org)

item.title: Inside the Damascus Dossier: From leaked images to verified data
item.description: ICIJ and its partners organized and analyzed thousands of chilling photographs to assemble comprehensive victim lists and quantify the human toll behind a sensitive data leak.

item.title: Tracing firms say Binance’s claims of improving financial crime left out key stats
item.description: Analytics firm Chainalysis said a Binance report claiming illicit activity on the platform plummeted failed to factor in funds stolen through hacks and ransomware.

item.title: Retailers keep cashing in on crypto ATMs as scams surge
item.description: Partnerships with convenience stores and gas stations fueled the rapid growth of crypto ATM networks — creating a fertile hunting ground for fraudsters.

item.title: Damascus Dossier stories from around the world
item.description: Reporters from 26 newsrooms across 20 countries uncovered new details about the Assad regime’s crimes — and how authorities are still seeking justice.

item.title: A film festival silenced — and the global reach of China’s repression
item.description: The abrupt cancellation of an independent Chinese film festival in New York reveals how Beijing and its proxies increasingly pressure critics abroad — a pattern documented by ICIJ and now drawing alarm at the United Nations and the European Parliament.

item.title: Elite Portuguese investigative unit to probe Spacey movie producer with ties to alleged crypto scammer
item.description: As international authorities warn the public against investing in Vladimir Okhotnikov’s latest crypto scheme, specialized prosecutors in Portugal are investigating the Ukrainian influencer who helped promote his start-ups.

item.title: ‘I’m on the right side of history’: ICIJ member Roman Anin stripped of his Russian citizenship
item.description: Authorities accused Anin and his former colleague Ekaterina Fomina of disseminating false information on the Russian Armed Forces.

item.title: Auditors at Bitpanda’s German subsidiary flagged information security issues, echoing regulator’s concerns
item.description: The crypto exchange said it had addressed authorities' concerns, but an internal report has cast doubt on those claims, according to a new investigation by ICIJ media partners.

item.title: New EU report urges more aggressive action against transnational repression
item.description: The report cites ICIJ’s China Targets investigation and calls for improved coordination across the bloc.

item.title: Asian financial hubs are reshaping Africa’s offshore economy
item.description: A new report shows how Dubai, Singapore and Hong Kong have courted African elites and companies with tax breaks, light regulation, and secrecy.
